trigger: rg.exe first execution returns access denied
action: Do not retry repeatedly; use bounded PowerShell Get-ChildItem + Select-String.

trigger: build/check fails with EBUSY while removing out
action: Stop the dedicated static server owning out, then rerun once.

trigger: worktree cleanup hits Filename too long
action: Use short worktree paths and repository-local core.longpaths; remove only exact confirmed residuals.
